questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some penguins are sharks.

Some sharks are dolphins.

**Conclusions (I): **No shark is a penguin.

**Conclusions (II):** Some penguins are dolphins.
questions.solution:
Given Statement:

Some penguins are sharks.

Some sharks are dolphins.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b06ec9d86b8d6776736ddd722e788b9a585d192aae2b5592289298144f9b0bff.png] 

Conclusions:

**I: No shark is a penguin.** This contradicts the first statement ("Some penguins are sharks"), which implies "Some sharks are penguins." Therefore, Conclusion (I) **does not follow**.

**II: Some penguins are dolphins.** This is true in Diagram II, but false in Diagram I. Since it is not true in all possible diagrams, Conclusion (II) **does not follow**.

So, **Neither conclusion I nor II follow.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: If 2 is added to each even digit and 1 is subtracted from each odd digit in the number 7364592, what will be the sum of the digits which are first from the left and first from the right in the new number thus formed?
questions.solution:
Given numbers: 7364592,

If 2 is added to each even digit and 1 is subtracted from each odd digit in the number, we get 6286484

The new number is 6286484.

Digit first from the left: 6

Digit first from the right: 4

Sum = 6 + 4 = 10

The sum of the digits is **10.**

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 3'**

questions.question:
In the following number-pairs, the second number is obtained by applying certain mathematical operations to the first number. Select the pair in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following pairs.

(**Note:** Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

24, 16

48, 32
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Multiply the first number by 2/3 to get the second number.**

24, 16

24 × (2/3) = 16

48, 32

48 × (2/3) = 32

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) 72, 36

72 × (2/3) = 48 (not 36) → Incorrect

**Option 2) 84, 56**

**84 × (2/3) = 56 → Correct**

Option 3) 60, 20

60 × (2/3) = 40 (not 20) → Incorrect

Option 4) 96, 62

96 × (2/3) = 64 (not 62) → Incorrect

Hence, the correct option is "Option 2"

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statement(s) is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All detergents are towels.

All detergents are conditioners.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some towels are conditioners.

(II) All conditioners are detergents.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All detergents are towels.

All detergents are conditioners.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83f4cce73335169d09c047df7bdeb7866b0d74a556c95b3bb5cac59eca053a98.png] 

Conclusions:

**(I) Some towels are conditioners:**

Since all Detergents are Towels, and all Detergents are Conditioners, the Detergents form the part of the Towels that are also Conditioners. 

Thus, there is an overlap. (I) logically follows.

**(II) All conditioners are detergents:**

This is the converse of Statement 2. 

The statements do not provide enough information to guarantee this is true. 

There may be conditioners that are not detergents. (II) does not follow.

So, **Only conclusion (I) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged and ‘−’ and ‘×’ are interchanged?

11 − 3 × 88 + 8 ÷ 10 = ?

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7751840ca1840d12cadc428f84d30e2cdcd5e7f82d52a57de21f2404c58eed88.png]

Now, ‘+’ ↔ ‘÷’ (interchanged) and ‘−’ ↔ ‘×’ (interchanged), then:

⇒ 11 × 3 − 88 ÷ 8 + 10 = ?

⇒ 33 − 11 + 10 = ?

⇒ 22 + 10 

= **32**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
